quote: I believe over the next decade computing will become even more ubiquitous and intelligence will become ambient.
page_note: Microsoft's own news site (Microsoft Source) printing Nadella's first-day email to employees, dated 2014-02-04; the sentence appears word for word under 'Why am I here?'.
role_at_the_time: chief executive of Microsoft (first day), though whether Microsoft in 2014 was a company building frontier AI models or chips is doubtful; the models and chips named in the role history came later
reason: 'Intelligence will become ambient' over the next decade is a broad vision of computing, with machine learning as only one of four drivers, not a clear forecast of what AI will do, so it is borderline under part 2 and stays out as borderline. Part 1 is also unclear, because in 2014 Microsoft did not yet build the AI models or chips that make it qualify.
